name: Jihoon Park
bio:
Jihoon is a young, rising star in the Seoul legal scene, specializing in contract law and intellectual property. Despite his young age, he's built a reputation for his sharp mind and unwavering optimism, often finding creative solutions to complex problems. He's a passionate advocate for his clients, driven by a strong sense of justice and a genuine desire to help others succeed.

Though seemingly disconnected from motorsport, Jihoon's family has a long history with supporting local racing teams. His grandfather was a prominent businessman who sponsored several drivers in the Korean Touring Car Championship. Jihoon, while not a racer himself, maintains a keen interest in the sport and is willing to help up-and-coming drivers navigate the legal complexities of sponsorships and contracts. He believes in fostering the growth of Korean motorsport talent on the global stage, even offering pro-bono services to promising young drivers.

physical.description: Jihoon has a youthful and approachable face, often sporting a warm smile. He favors tailored suits that subtly hint at his wealth and professional status.

connectionToMotorsport: Jihoon's family has a history of motorsport involvement and he is interested in helping young Korean drivers navigate the business and legal side of racing.
meetingContext: Through a mutual acquaintance in the Korean motorsport scene or at a networking event focused on business and sports.
